column2: do you know who's staying near your room?”

“It might make for a pretty interesting read.{r}{p}But there's a better way than that.{r}{p}Instead of a publisher, sell it to some country.{r}{p}There are plenty of countries dying to get their hands on everything 'Kamaitachi' has gathered about US forces in Japan and the Self-Defense Forces
With my face pressed to the floor, I spoke in broken fragments.
I realized at once that I'd answered wrong.
“Looks like you know what 'Kamaitachi' is without being told.”
I desperately searched for a way to talk myself out of it, but found none.
The instant I started to speak, a sharp pain shot through my twisted arm.
“Do you want me to get rougher?{r}{p}Now tell me who hired you.{r}{p}Or else…”
Thinking I could fix things by clearing up the misunderstanding, I tried to talk.
{n2} was desperately holding down Aki Kawamura's hand, trying to turn her face away from the tip of the ice pick.
We're not the ones who killed her!”
I shouted, flustered, unable even to approach.
Whether justice was trampled, whether Japan, America, or any country in the world fell, it was none of my concern.
only {n2} was someone irreplaceable and precious to me; I understood that clearly now.
I don't want you to die for me.{r}{p}Live.
{n2} said it with a laugh, but her eyes seemed a little moist.
